## Clean data

```{r}
#| label: extract data

expression <- Biobase::exprs(GSE24504_raw)
# columns ("GSM60...") = samples (one sample of one organ of one mouse after one time)
# rows (1 to 22680) = number of microarray probe
# values = normalized log2 ratio Cy3/Cy5 (test/reference)

samples <- Biobase::pData(GSE24504_raw)
# description of the samples

genes <- Biobase::fData(GSE24504_raw)


```

```{r}
#| label: new dataframe

samples_clean <- samples |> 
  select(title, 
         geo_accession, 
         source_name_ch1, 
         `mouse:ch1`,
         `timepoint:ch1`,
         `tissue:ch1`) |> 
  rename(mouse = `mouse:ch1`,
         timepoint = `timepoint:ch1`,
         tissue = `tissue:ch1`)


expression_entrezid <- expression |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "ID") |> 
  full_join(genes |> 
              dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |> 
              select(ENTREZ_ID, ID, FLAG),
            by = "ID") |> 
  dplyr::relocate(ENTREZ_ID, FLAG, .before = 1) |> 
  filter(FLAG == "0") |> 
  select(-ID, -FLAG)


expression_long <- expression_entrezid |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -ENTREZ_ID, 
               names_to = "geo_accession", 
               values_to = "expression")
```

```{r}
#| label: join for final dataframe

dat_clean_long <- full_join(samples_clean, expression_long, by = "geo_accession") 

dat_avg <- dat_clean_long |>
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZ_ID)) |>
  group_by(title, geo_accession, source_name_ch1, mouse, timepoint, tissue, ENTREZ_ID) |>
  summarise(expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

dir.create("../data")

write.table(
  x = dat_avg,
  file = "../data/data_aug",
  sep = "\t"
)
```

### Update the labels

```{r}
#| label: loading packages

# Install Bioconductor packages (run only once)
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install(c("org.Mm.eg.db", "AnnotationDbi"))
```

```{r}
#| label: updating annotations

#load packages
library(dplyr)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)


#| label: update annotations

# 1. Prepare accession numbers
genes_to_update <- genes %>%
  mutate(
    GB_ACC_clean = sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", as.character(GB_ACC))
  )

# 2. Get unique accessions
accessions <- unique(na.omit(genes_to_update$GB_ACC_clean))
accessions <- accessions[accessions != ""]

# 3. Retrieve annotations using RefSeq
annotation_raw <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = accessions,
  keytype = "REFSEQ",
  columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL", "GENENAME")
)

# 4. Summarize annotations
get_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(as.character(x)))
  if (length(x) == 1) x else NA_character_
}

annotation_summary <- annotation_raw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data[["REFSEQ"]]) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    ENTREZ_ID_new = get_unique(ENTREZID),
    SYMBOL_new = get_unique(SYMBOL),
    GENENAME_new = get_unique(GENENAME),
    n_entrez = dplyr::n_distinct(na.omit(ENTREZID)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GB_ACC_clean = REFSEQ)

# 5. Join with original data
genes_updated <- genes_to_update %>%
  left_join(annotation_summary, by = "GB_ACC_clean")

# 6. Create updated annotation columns
genes_updated <- genes_updated %>%
  mutate(
    ENTREZ_ID_updated = coalesce(ENTREZ_ID_new, as.character(ENTREZ_ID)),
    SYMBOL_updated = coalesce(SYMBOL_new, as.character(SYMBOL)),
    GENENAME_updated = coalesce(GENENAME_new, as.character(GENENAME))
  )

#tidy the data
genes_updated <- genes_updated %>%
  mutate(
    ENTREZ_ID = coalesce(ENTREZ_ID_new, as.character(ENTREZ_ID)),
    SYMBOL = coalesce(SYMBOL_new, as.character(SYMBOL)),
    GENENAME = coalesce(GENENAME_new, as.character(GENENAME))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -GB_ACC_clean,
    -ENTREZ_ID_new,
    -SYMBOL_new,
    -GENENAME_new,
    -n_entrez,
    -ENTREZ_ID_updated,
    -SYMBOL_updated,
    -GENENAME_updated
  )
```
